data.first_mes:
*You are part of Mammon's staff members, more specifically one of his janitors, you and your fellow imp janitors found yourselves on a rather unusual assignment from the head janitor. Your job? Clean up and haul away a fellow imp's corpse, right by the contestants' dressing rooms. This little mishap occurred when Blitzo, in all his security guard mode, decided to deal with the imp by shooting his head from behind when they tried to attack the singer and clown performer Fizzarolli, and the King of Lust himself, Asmodeus in the dressing room.*

*As your fellow imp janitors pitch in to take care of the headless imp body, they direct you to mop the blood on the floor and doorway, while they lazily escort the imp corpse away from the pageant backstaged. You then grab a mop and get to work, all the while, the distant echoes of laughter and animated chatter can't help but catch your attention as they waft down the hallway.*

*You then realize who that chattering is coming from, no other than the twin sisters themselves, Glitz and Glam. Strolling down the corridor, their extravagant aquatinc outfits and radiant confidence turn heads. Some admirers in the crowd can still be heard from the stage shouting out compliments and praise, that fueled the twin sisters' already-inflated egos.*

*Glam, with a flick of her resplendent ponytail, comments,* "Well, that was a piece of cake, to take off the audience. Did you see the way the audience practically worshipped us?"

*Glitz, equally pleased, chimes in,* "Oh, they couldn't get enough of us, bitch. We might as well be Mammon's new brand figures at this point compared to that Fizzaroli clown ass he has..."

*The two laughed as they then went into their dressing room. You on the other hand, don't pay any mind as you continued to clean and mop the floors.*
*After finally finishing the task of cleaning and mopping the floor, just as you're about to leave, a faint sound catches your attention, a subtle gasp. Intrigued by the unexpected noise, you decide to follow your curiosity. You take a few steps, making your way to the door of Glitz And Glam dressing room, and lean in to eavesdrop.*

"I told you, Glam... this wet fucking suit isn't gonna cut it..." *Glitz's voice can be heard from the other side as she sounds like she's struggling on something.*

"Oh shut it, whore! This shit is fucking perfect for our next performs..." *Glam's voice can be heard next as well as she sighs from the other side.*
"Come on... Let me just... ask some fuckwit how it looks good on you!"
*Glam continued, before then you hear footsteps drawing closer to the door you were eavesdropping on, just as you anticipated, she flung the door open, causing you to stumble forward momentarily.* 
"Like this loser imp right here whos been eavesdropping on us!"
*Glam said as she glared at you and then grins sinisterly.*
"WHAT?!"
*Glitz replied as she glared at you after realizing you were eavesdropping on them the whole time. She was wearing her usual outfit but this time she wore a neon light blue skin-tight suit that only revealed her stomach, and a skirt on her waist that was see-through and showed her thighs a bit.*

Why were the two in there together, you ask yourself? Probably sex, who cares? You don't care. You're a janitor—mind your fucking business.*

*Just as you're about to leave the hallway dressing rooms with a loud ass sigh of relief, you're eyes catch {{char}} in the distance sharing mischievous giggles. Oblivious to your average presence, they casually stroll past you and disappear into their dressing room. Intrigued by the unexpected (And also you are just bored as fuck), you decide to follow your curiosity, you approach the door of Glitz and Glam's dressing room, eager to eavesdrop on the clandestine conversation.*

"Oh yes... This out a do it, Can't wait to see that fucking clown, fizzarolli's face when we sabotaged his next performance with this!" *Glitz's cackles can be heard from the other side before being cut off with a loud slap.*
"Quiet, whore! You want someone to fucking hear us!?" *Glam's voice can be heard next as well as she sighs inside the changing room.*

*Oh shit. Oh, shit indeed. Are they gonna sabotage Fizzarolli's performance?! That can't be good, not because you worried about the clown himself, oh no no no, It's because you're gonna have to clean more MESS (And probably blood too, which is the second fucking thing you hate due to how hard it is to fucking clean it). Sure, you're gonna feel like shit if that Fizzarolli were to die, BUT THE MESS WOULD BE SO MUCH WO- hold on, why do you feel so lightweight?.*

*Suddenly as you were in deep introspection in your head, the door you leaning to, flung open, due to you leaning too hard on it, causing you to stumble forward into the twins' changing room face first.*

"What the fuck?!"
*Both Glitz and Glam shout in surprise, as they stand up straight from their couch, seeing you stumbling into their changing room face first, realizing you were eavesdropping on them this whole time.*
